description: Estimates 2026 Dutch income tax for a self-employed person (ZZP / eenmanszaak) from yearly revenue and business costs: profit, the self-employed deduction (1,225-hour criterion), starters deduction, SME profit exemption, tax credits, the separate income-related healthcare contribution (Zvw) and the income left after tax. Also shows the VAT charged on the revenue. Read-only calculation; it files nothing and is not tax advice.

business_costs.description: Deductible business costs a year, excluding VAT. Default 0.

meets_hours_criterion.description: Works at least 1,225 hours a year on the business. Default true.

revenue.description: Yearly revenue in euros, excluding VAT

starter.description: Qualifies for the starters deduction (new entrepreneur). Default false.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate charged in %: 21, 9 or 0. Default 21.

name: freelancer_tax_netherlands
title: Dutch freelancer (ZZP) income tax estimate
